_comment: Ember, the Help channel assistant (server/tools/helpai.py; server/README.md 'Help channel assistant'). Read at start; restart the sidecar after a change. chaos.env may override: CHAOS_HELPAI=0 (off), CHAOS_HELPAI_MODEL, CHAOS_HELPAI_MONTHLY_USD, CHAOS_HELPAI_LOG_QUESTIONS=1.
_comment_prices: USD per million tokens of the model above (published list price, prompts of 100K tokens or fewer, checked 2026-10). Cache writes cost cacheWriteFactor x input, cache reads cacheReadFactor x input. Change them with the model.
